description: Ireland: overpay the mortgage, invest, or top up a pension?

accessAge.description: Age the pension can be drawn (default 60)

depositRatePct.description: Deposit rate for freed payments, % AER (default 2.5)

growthPct.description: Market growth % a year after charges (default 5, an assumption)

mode.description: After overpaying: keep the payment and shorten the term (default), or reduce the payment

pay.description: Gross pay a year for the pension limit, EUR (default 60000)

pensionContributions.description: Own pension contributions already paid each year, EUR (default 0)

retirementRate.description: Income tax rate in retirement, 20 or 40 (default: same as now)

name: ireland_overpay_mortgage_or_invest
